Pre-Conditions: User is on Home Page with store password entered.
Test Steps: 1) Click the search icon/field. 2) Leave it empty. 3) Press Enter or click Search.
Expected Result: No crash; shows a prompt or the full catalogue, not an error page.

Test Steps: 1) Click search field. 2) Type a single letter. 3) Submit.
Expected Result: Returns broad matches or a "refine your search" hint, no timeout.

Test Steps: 1) Click search field. 2) Type only spaces. 3) Submit.
Expected Result: Treated as an empty query, not a literal 0-result match.

Test Steps: 1) Click search field. 2) Paste a 500+ character string. 3) Submit.
Expected Result: No server error; input is capped or handled without layout break.

Test Steps: 1) Click search field. 2) Enter the payload. 3) Submit.
Expected Result: Treated as literal text; no error leakage or data exposure.

Test Steps: 1) Click search field. 2) Enter the payload. 3) Submit.
Expected Result: Rendered as plain text in results/UI, never executed.

Test Steps: 1) Click search field. 2) Enter a string with no matches. 3) Submit.
Expected Result: Clean "no results found" state with suggestions, not a blank/broken page.

Test Steps: 1) Search using all uppercase. 2) Repeat search using all lowercase. 3) Compare result sets.
Expected Result: Identical result sets for both searches.

Test Steps: 1) Search with leading/trailing spaces around a valid term. 2) Compare to the trimmed term.
Expected Result: Trimmed automatically; same results as "shirt".

Test Steps: 1) Click search field. 2) Enter an emoji. 3) Submit.
Expected Result: Handled gracefully - no results or a matched product, never an error.

Pre-Conditions: User is on Home Page with a quick-add product visible.
Test Steps: 1) Click Add to Cart twice within 300ms on the same product.
Expected Result: One line item added, not two; quantity not doubled.

Pre-Conditions: An out-of-stock product is visible on Home Page.
Test Steps: 1) Locate an out-of-stock product. 2) Attempt to click Add to Cart.
Expected Result: Button disabled or blocked with a "sold out" message.

Pre-Conditions: A variant product (size/colour) is visible on Home Page.
Test Steps: 1) Attempt Add to Cart without selecting a variant.
Expected Result: Blocked with a clear prompt to select a variant.

Test Steps: 1) Set quantity equal to remaining stock. 2) Click Add to Cart.
Expected Result: Succeeds; item now shows as sold out.

Test Steps: 1) Set quantity to stock+1. 2) Click Add to Cart.
Expected Result: Blocked, capped at available stock, with a clear message.

Test Steps: 1) Set quantity to 0. 2) Attempt Add to Cart.
Expected Result: Add to Cart disabled or rejected.

Pre-Conditions: User is viewing a product with a wishlist icon.
Test Steps: 1) Click the wishlist/heart icon. 2) Click it again on the same product.
Expected Result: No duplicate entry; icon reflects "already saved" state.

Test Steps: 1) Click wishlist icon on a product while logged out.
Expected Result: Persists via cookie/local storage, or clearly prompts login - verify against intended design.

Test Steps: 1) Open wishlist. 2) Remove the only item.
Expected Result: Empty-wishlist state renders correctly, no broken layout.

Pre-Conditions: An item has been added to wishlist.
Test Steps: 1) Add item to wishlist. 2) Clear cookies/local storage. 3) Reload page.
Expected Result: Behaviour matches intended persistence model (session vs account-based).

Test Steps: 1) Click the wishlist icon 10 times rapidly.
Expected Result: Final on/off state is consistent with actual stored list - no desync.

Pre-Conditions: Compare tray is at its max capacity minus one.
Test Steps: 1) Add products until the limit. 2) Attempt to add one more.
Expected Result: Blocked with a message stating the limit; oldest item not silently dropped.

Test Steps: 1) Click Add to Compare. 2) Click it again on the same product.
Expected Result: Not duplicated in the compare tray.

Pre-Conditions: Compare tray contains exactly one item.
Test Steps: 1) Open the compare page/tray with a single item.
Expected Result: Table/tray renders sensibly, not a broken single-column layout.

Pre-Conditions: Two products from different categories are added to compare.
Test Steps: 1) Add products from different categories. 2) Open compare view.
Expected Result: Table aligns rows correctly or shows "-" for missing attributes.

Test Steps: 1) Remove every item from the compare tray.
Expected Result: Clean empty state.

Pre-Conditions: A blog post without a featured image exists.
Test Steps: 1) Open blog listing. 2) Locate the post without an image.
Expected Result: Placeholder shown, no broken image icon.

Test Scenario: Last pagination page with one post
Pre-Conditions: Blog has a trailing page with a single post.
Test Steps: 1) Navigate to the last pagination page.
Expected Result: Grid doesn't collapse oddly with a single card.

Pre-Conditions: A post with a long title exists.
Test Steps: 1) Open blog listing. 2) Inspect the long-title card.
Expected Result: Wraps within card, no overflow past container edge.

Test Steps: 1) Navigate directly to an invalid blog post slug.
Expected Result: Themed 404 page, not a raw server error.

Test Steps: 1) Leave email field empty. 2) Click Submit.
Expected Result: Inline validation, no page reload or console error.

Test Steps: 1) Enter each malformed value in turn. 2) Submit each.
Expected Result: Rejected with a clear inline message for each.

Test Steps: 1) Enter a plus-alias email. 2) Submit.
Expected Result: Accepted.

Test Steps: 1) Submit the same email a second time.
Expected Result: Graceful "already subscribed" message - not a duplicate-record error.

Test Steps: 1) Enter an email with a very long local part. 2) Submit.
Expected Result: Rejected cleanly or handled without breaking layout.

Test Steps: 1) Enter an email with surrounding spaces. 2) Submit.
Expected Result: Trimmed and accepted.

Test Steps: 1) Enter a script payload as the email. 2) Submit.
Expected Result: Rejected as invalid email; never reflected unescaped.

Test Steps: 1) Click each social media icon in turn.
Expected Result: Opens correct platform in a new tab (target=_blank rel=noopener).

Test Steps: 1) Inspect each footer link's href.
Expected Result: Flag as defect if any footer link is still a dead placeholder.

Test Steps: 1) Click About, Contact, and Policy links in turn.
Expected Result: None return a 404.

Test Steps: 1) Tab through the footer using only the keyboard.
Expected Result: Logical order, visible focus state on every link.

Pre-Conditions: A subcategory with a long name exists.

Pre-Conditions: User is on a category page with filters.
Test Steps: 1) Apply a filter. 2) Check the product count updates.

Test Steps: 1) Open the collection page. 2) Inspect the count formatting.

Pre-Conditions: User is on a collection page.

Pre-Conditions: A category's last pagination page has one item.

Pre-Conditions: A multi-page category listing is open.

Expected Result: No duplicate/skipped requests, final page matches last click.

Pre-Conditions: Price filter is visible on category page.
Test Steps: 1) Set min price higher than max price. 2) Apply filter.
Expected Result: Validation message or auto-swap - not a silent, unexplained 0 results.

Test Steps: 1) Set min and max to the same value. 2) Apply filter.

Test Steps: 1) Set min to 0 and max to the highest listed price. 2) Apply filter.
Expected Result: Includes the cheapest and priciest items.

Test Steps: 1) Enter a negative value in min price. 2) Apply filter.

Test Steps: 1) Enter letters into the price field. 2) Apply filter.

Expected Result: Inclusive - item appears in results.

Test Steps: 1) Set a range that falls between two price clusters. 2) Apply filter.
Expected Result: Clean empty state.

Pre-Conditions: A brand filter option with zero in-stock items exists.
Test Steps: 1) Select that brand filter.
Expected Result: Empty state; brand itself still listed or hidden per rule.

Test Steps: 1) Select all brand checkboxes. 2) Deselect all.
Expected Result: Returns to the unfiltered listing correctly.

Test Steps: 1) Select two different brands simultaneously.
Expected Result: Confirm OR logic (union) is what's intended, not AND.

Test Scenario: Brand + price combined with no overlap
Pre-Conditions: Brand and price filters are available.
Test Steps: 1) Select a brand and a price range with no matching products.
Expected Result: Empty state; filters stay visibly applied.

Pre-Conditions: A product type filter with zero results exists.
Test Steps: 1) Select that product type filter.
Expected Result: Clean empty state.

Pre-Conditions: All three filter groups are available.
Test Steps: 1) Apply a product type, brand, and price filter together.
Expected Result: Filters compound (AND across groups) correctly.

Test Scenario: Clear single filter vs clear all
Test Steps: 1) Clear one filter individually. 2) Reapply filters, then click Clear All.
Expected Result: Both work independently and update the listing/count.

Test Steps: 1) Select "In stock" only.
Expected Result: Out-of-stock items excluded.

Pre-Conditions: A category with zero in-stock items exists.
Test Steps: 1) Select "In stock" only on that category.
Expected Result: Empty state, not a crash or infinite loader.

Test Scenario: Sort price low-high with tied prices
Pre-Conditions: At least two products share the same price.
Test Steps: 1) Sort by price low to high. 2) Refresh and re-check order.
Expected Result: Stable secondary order - doesn't reshuffle on refresh.

Pre-Conditions: A category with exactly one product exists.
Test Steps: 1) Apply any sort option.
Expected Result: No error, single item shown.

Test Scenario: Best selling on category with 0 sales

Pre-Conditions: Filters are applied on a category page.

Pre-Conditions: A product titled with a leading symbol exists.

Test Steps: 1) Open that product's PDP.

Test Steps: 1) Open that product's PDP. 2) Attempt to add to cart and check out.
